caption: bill newton's neck-defying physics climb - gas, brake, and a very fragile head.
about: Hill climb racing is the two-pedal physics runner: gas and brake, undulating hills, and a driver whose neck snaps if the landing goes wrong. Coins buy vehicles and stage unlocks, upgrades genuinely change the physics, and the loop is honest about what it is - the best five-minute drive in the windows store.
The store listing is free, and store.rg-adguard mirrors the appx package for offline installs.

req.note: below target - casual 2d physics; the bar is a formality.
